label: ATEN KN2124VA 24-port KVM over IP switch
description: 1-local/2-remote Cat 5 KVM over IP switch with 24 RJ-45 KVM server ports (expandable to 40 in 1RU) and two 10/100/1000 Mbps NICs for redundant LAN or dual-IP operation.
notes: Zero RS-232 ports: the 24 server-side ports are proprietary Cat5 KVM ports (video + USB + virtual media via KA71xx dongles), not Ethernet, so they are not modelled as ethernet interfaces - the box therefore appears with only its 2 management NICs. Dual power supplies, LUC USB laptop console port (not modelled), FIPS 140-2 level 1, HTML5 WebClient, Panel Array Mode, CC2000/CCVSR integration. KN2124VA is discontinued; KN2124VB is the drop-in replacement. Typical use: IP reach into a rack whose servers have no serial console at all.
